decision: Implement an opt-in single-CTA multiple-sweep Jacobi action for small CSR AMG levels, preserving simultaneous updates and existing large-level vendor path; benchmark before promotion.
limitations: The suspended sanitizer retained its CUDA context and about 1550 MiB; it was not computing.
GPU quiescence verified by three 0-percent samples before run; no continuous external-workload monitoring.
Phase boundaries synchronize and perturb execution; phase times are diagnostic and not CUDA-event kernel times.
No candidate optimization was measured here; this is a baseline, not a speedup claim.
Affine hex Helmholtz k=5 with natural Neumann boundaries only.
